title: Ordinary rational root-line extension to the closure
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate field in its fixed padic algebraic closure, and X a scheme with ell invertible in its global sections. Use the actual pulled-back condensed coefficients, rational root line, closure root-line colimit and closureLineMap [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps]. There is an isomorphism from ordinary scalar extension of spRationalTwist X ell E along the actual inclusion E to the closure to spQbarTwist X ell, such that the ordinary extension unit followed by its underlying hom is exactly closureLineMap. This has no direct-image or derived assertion.

proof.text: Apply the normalized colimit-leg factorization for the finite rational root line.
The factorization map is invertible by slicewise normalized root bases and joint conservativity.
Package the invertible factorization map as the requested module isomorphism; its normalization is the factorization equation.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalClosure_ordinaryLine
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ q : (Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) X)).obj
          (spRationalTwist X l E) ≅ spQbarTwist X l,
      Mod.extendUnitHom (coefficientMap (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) X)
          (spRationalTwist X l E) ≫ q.hom.hom = closureLineMap l E X
